'''1999 Dagobah Regionals''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament for the Dagobah region in 1999. [[Jason Burrows]] won it.<ref name="ls114">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls114.htm Adapt And Destroy], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040819083207/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls114.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Date:''' 25 September 1999<ref name="tr-d55" />
* '''Site:''' Dagobah region; Tallahassee, Florida<ref name="tr-d55" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Burrows]]<ref name="tr-d60" />
== Dating ==

The deck page says the deck did well "at the 99 Dagobah regional event".
